fields.statement: QA with a binary built from 0d62831c in a scratch repo: rhiza daemon settings lists rhiza.daemon.usage.session and .weekly unset and .reserve 20 by default; daemon set took reserve 25 and session/weekly token counts; reserve 101, session 1.5 and weekly abc each exited 2 with a clear message; settings --json shows the git config source.

QA against this machine's real ~/.claude/projects (335 transcripts, 215MB): UsageRecords read 5897 records in about 6 s; rhiza health's usage part showed non-zero session and weekly use, and with HOME pointed at a missing dir it showed 0 for both. Correct but slow: every call re-reads and parses every transcript (see the qa finding).

QA: seeded .git/rhiza/usage.limits.jsonl with a hit resetting 2h later, one resetting 4 days later, one with no reset and a garbage line, then ran rhiza daemon --once with no limit settings over real transcripts. The state's learned list had session 2772142 and weekly 16403273 tokens at those hits; the no-reset hit and the bad line taught nothing. The learned session limit held (reset moved to the hit's 06:39:21Z). Setting rhiza.daemon.usage.session and .weekly to 1e9 won over the learned limits and cleared the hold.

QA with real daemon --once polls (no seeded state): with session limit 1000 the state saved usage_hold; daemon status showed the settings, health showed warn usage with the window/use/limit/reserve/reset detail and inbox listed one usage-reserve item. After raising the limit, the next --once cleared usage_hold, health's usage part was ok (session N of limit; weekly N, no limit known) and the inbox was empty. The per-change-set skip was not exercised by hand (no accepted change set in the scratch repo).

QA: rhiza daemon --once with a tiny session limit held (started/resumed/planned empty, usage_hold saved), and with a large limit it did not. Over real transcripts, though, the current session window depends on the 2x-window lookback: at the same instant usage.Current gave start 23:38:27Z, 4564260 used, reset 04:38:27Z with a 10h lookback but start 03:48:10Z, 1280338 used, reset 08:48:10Z with a 30h one. Consecutive health calls showed session use drop with no reset, and the reported reset moved from 04:38:27Z to about 04:45Z ten seconds later. Live-run projection was not exercised by hand.
